entries.tutorial.replay_tooltip: Replay the guided first-run mission on your next match
entries.tutorial.skip_tooltip: Dismiss the tutorial and remember this choice
entries.tutorial.select.title: MUSTER YOUR FORCES
entries.tutorial.select.body: Select one of your units or structures to inspect it and reveal its available orders.
entries.tutorial.select.fallback: Try selecting your stronghold or one of the workers beside it. Selection details appear in the command deck.
entries.tutorial.select.input.keyboard_mouse: Left-click a friendly unit or drag a selection box.
entries.tutorial.select.input.gamepad: Move the right stick cursor, then press A over a friendly unit.
entries.tutorial.select.input.touch: Tap a friendly unit or structure.
entries.tutorial.command.title: ISSUE AN ORDER
entries.tutorial.command.body: Command selected units to move, gather, build, or attack. Every order changes the battlefield simulation.
entries.tutorial.command.fallback: Select workers, then order them onto jade, lumber, or a construction site.
entries.tutorial.command.input.keyboard_mouse: Right-click a destination or use a command-card action.
entries.tutorial.command.input.gamepad: Move the cursor and press X for a contextual order, or use a focused command button.
entries.tutorial.command.input.touch: Tap ORDER for gathering, construction, repair, or deposit; MOVE and ATTACK arm ground orders.
entries.tutorial.production.title: EXPAND THE MANDATE
entries.tutorial.production.body: Select a production structure and queue a unit. Production consumes resources and population capacity.
entries.tutorial.production.fallback: Select your stronghold to train a worker, or a completed military structure to train troops.
entries.tutorial.production.input.keyboard_mouse: Choose a unit in the command card; Space queues the first available unit.
entries.tutorial.production.input.gamepad: Focus a production button and press A.
entries.tutorial.production.input.touch: Tap a production structure, then tap a unit in the command card.
entries.tutorial.objective.title: ADVANCE AN OBJECTIVE
entries.tutorial.objective.body: Secure food, capture a yaoguai den, hatch the Shenlong egg, and defeat all rivals.
entries.tutorial.objective.fallback: The objective panel at upper left tracks progress. A rice farm is the quickest first milestone.
entries.tutorial.objective.input.keyboard_mouse: Build a food structure or advance any objective shown at upper left.
entries.tutorial.objective.input.gamepad: Use the command card to build, train, and contest objectives.
entries.tutorial.objective.input.touch: Use the command deck and battlefield taps to advance an objective.
entries.tutorial.pause.title: CONTROL THE TEMPO
entries.tutorial.pause.body: Pause to resume, restart, return to title, or tune presentation settings without losing context.
entries.tutorial.pause.fallback: The pause control is in the upper HUD beside the resource readouts.
entries.tutorial.pause.input.keyboard_mouse: Press P or Escape, or click the pause icon.
entries.tutorial.pause.input.touch: Tap the pause icon in the upper HUD.
entries.tutorial.tweaks.title: TUNE THE BATTLEFIELD
entries.tutorial.tweaks.body: Open Tweak Controls to adjust live UI, audio, camera, environment, and gameplay parameters.
entries.tutorial.tweaks.fallback: Tweak Controls sits above the command deck at lower right. Gameplay changes mark the current run unranked.
entries.tutorial.tweaks.input.keyboard_mouse: Click TWEAK CONTROLS at lower right.
entries.tutorial.tweaks.input.gamepad: Navigate focus to TWEAK CONTROLS and press A.
entries.tutorial.tweaks.input.touch: Tap TWEAK CONTROLS at lower right.
